newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec says to set US$750 mln 10-year global bond.
newsitem.headline: Quebec says to set US$750 mln 10-year global bond.

text.p: Quebec Finance Minister Bernard Landry on Tuesday said the province intends to launch a 10-year US$750 million global bond issue if market conditions remain favorable.

The bonds will be simultaneously offered to investors in the United States, Europe, Asia and Canada, said a statement from Landry. The statement said Nomura and SEC Warburg will act as joint-lead managers of the new issue, while Credit Suisse First Boston, Goldman Sachs and Merrill Lynch will be the book runners.
European syndicate managers on Monday said they expected Quebec to set a US$1.0 billion, 10-year global bond this week.
